sourceTitle: Parturition without pain or loss of consciousness
description: "Parturition without Pain or Loss of Consciousness" by James Townley is a scientific publication written in the early 1860s. This work focuses on the use of an anodyne in childbirth, presenting a novel method intended to alleviate labor pains while maintaining the mother's consciousness.
